project.name: Solo Idea Hunt
project.goal: One analyst, working alone under the full rulebook: find and defend one investment idea in US-listed equities within 30 days that I would be willing to act on. The output is a single note — the business, the numbers over eight quarters, why the market is wrong, the bear case stated as a bear would state it, what would falsify the thesis, and the size it deserves given the downside. Breadth is not the goal: one idea with an argument that survives attack beats ten screened names. If 30 days of work produces nothing defensible, say so — that is a real finding and it is the honest deliverable. Research only; no orders, no advice to anyone else.
